gen.title: Unpowered Flight and Steady Descent Review

cards.stem: What characterizes a glider as a special kind of aircraft
cards.quote: A glider is a special kind of aircraft that has no engine.
cards.hint: Think about what powers this aircraft type

cards.stem: What name is given to the angle where the steady flight path meets the ground
cards.quote: The flight path intersects the ground at an angle a called the glide angle.
cards.hint: Recall the term for the inclined flight path intersection

cards.stem: For calculating the glide angle with trigonometry what is divided by distance flown
cards.quote: The tangent tan of the glide angle a is equal to the change in height h divided by the distance flown d:
cards.hint: Focus on the height component in the ratio

cards.stem: In the steady descent vector balance what equals the combined lift and drag components
cards.quote: The lift L times the cosine cos of the glide angle plus the drag D times the sine sin of the glide angle is equal to the weight W:
cards.hint: Consider which downward force is balanced in steady flight
